LEASETERMINATIONAGREEMENT THIS LEASE TERMINATION AGREEMENT (this “Agreement"), made as of the 3rd day of March, 2005, between NEW YORK CITY INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT public benefit corporation of the State of New York, duly organized and existing under the laws of the State of New York (the “Agency"), having its principal office at 110 William Street, New York, New York, and NMS WASTE PAPER REMOVAL, INC.,a corporation duly organized and existing under and by virtue of the laws of the State of New York (the “Lessee"), having its principal office at 58-25 47h Street, Maspeth, New York 11378 (capitalized terms used but not defined herein shall have the respective meanings assigned to such terms in the Lease or Indenture referred tobelow): WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, on December 19, 1989, pursuant to an Indenture of Mortgage and Trust, dated as of December 1, 1989 (the “Indenture"), between the Agency and The Bank of New York, as trustee (the“Trustee"), recorded on or about December 29,1989, in the Office of the Register of The City of New York, Queens County, New York in Reel 2928 and Page 2152, the Agency issued its $1,800,000 Industrial Development Revenue Bonds (1989 NMS Waste Paper Removal, Inc. Project) (the “Bonds") to finance an industrial facility (the “Facility") in the City of New York, consisting of the acquisition of approximately 35,000 square feet of an existing one-story building and related real property, all for use in the reclaiming and recycling Exhibit Battached hereto and made a part hereof); and WHEREAS,the Agency and the Lessee entered into a Lease Agreement, dated as of December 1,1989 (the “Lease"), recorded on or about December 29, 1989 in the office of the Register of the City of New York,Queens County, New York, in Reel 2928 and Page 2246, whereby the Agency leased the Facility to the Lessee; and WHEREAS,the Lessee has terminated its operations at the Facility and has been in default in its payments under the Lease with respect to, among other matters, amounts due under the Bonds and payments in lieu of real estate taxes with respect to the Facility ("PILOT"); and WHEREAS,the Lessee desires to terminate the Lease and sell the Facility and has entered in the settlement arrangements with the Holders of the Bonds and with the Agency with respect to the satisfaction of amounts due under the Bonds and unpaid PILOT; and WHEREAS,upon the receipt by the Holders of the Bonds of the negotiated settlement amount and the surrender of the Bonds by the Holders thereof to the Trustee for cancellation, the Lessee intends to exercise its option pursuant to Section 8.(d) of the Lease to acquire theAgency'sinterest in theFacility; and 448594.4 027152 TERM

WHEREAS, concurrently with the execution of this Agreement, pursuant to Section 8.1(d) of the Lease, the Lessee shall pay as the purchase price an amount equal to: (1)the sum of one dollar; and (2) the fees and expenses of the Agency,the Trustee, the Bond Registrar and the Paying Agents and all other amounts due and payable under the Lease (except to the extentreduced by settlement) or theIndenture,together with any amountsrequired to be rebated to the Federal government pursuant to the Indenture or the Tax Regulatory Agreement; and WHEREAS,the Agency and the Lessee desire toterminate the Lease in accordance with this Agreement; and WHEREAS, all necessary consents, opinions and notices for the execution of this Agreement have been either obtained or waived; NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the premises and the respective Section 1. Release. Subject toreceiptof thepaymentdescribed in Section 2 below, the Agency hereby releases the Lessee (and its members, directors, officers, employees, agents and servants and persons under its control or supervision) from and against any additional claims for PILOT Payments, or interest thereon or default penalty with respect thereto. Section 2.Payments.The Lessee hereby agrees to pay to the NewYork City Department of Finance by certified check or same day wired funds, the amount of $1,326,200.53 as payment in full for defaulted PILOT Payments under the Lease, being 2004 through and includingMarch3,2005of $126,200.53. Section 3.Termination of the Lease.The Agency and the Lessee hereby agree that upon making the payment described in Section 2 above, the Lease is terminated and cancelled as of the date hereof, subject to the survival of the obligations of the Lessee under Sections 6.2 and 9.17 of theLease,and any other provisions of the Lease which specifically state by their terms that they survive termination of said Lease, which provisions are personal to the Lesseeanddonotrunwiththeland. Section 4.Counterparts. This Agreement may be simultaneously executed in several counterparts, each of which shall be an original and all of which shall constitute but one and the same instrument. 448594.4 027152 TERM
